# routeur_dlp_policy (Resource)

A data-loss-prevention policy in a workspace. It scans prompts (and responses) for a pattern, a managed preset, keywords or secret formats, and applies an action when something matches. Policies at workspace and project level compose: a call is matched by its workspace's policies and its project's. Choose the detector with `detector` and set the one payload argument that belongs to it: `pattern` for `regex`, `presets` for `preset`, `keywords` for `keyword`, `secrets` for `secret`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "payments" {
  slug = "payments"
  name = "Payments"
}

resource "routeur_project" "checkout" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "checkout"
  name         = "Checkout"
}

# Redact card numbers and email addresses (managed presets) everywhere in the workspace.
resource "routeur_dlp_policy" "pii" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "pii"
  name         = "PII"
  detector     = "preset"
  presets      = ["email", "credit_card"]
  action       = "redact"
  severity     = "high"
}

# Block a custom RE2 pattern, for one project only.
resource "routeur_dlp_policy" "internal_ticket" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  project_id   = routeur_project.checkout.id
  slug         = "internal_ticket"
  name         = "Internal ticket ids"
  detector     = "regex"
  pattern      = "\\bPAY-[0-9]{3,6}\\b"
  action       = "block"
  severity     = "medium"
}

# Warn on keywords (case-insensitive substrings).
resource "routeur_dlp_policy" "codenames" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "codenames"
  name         = "Codenames"
  detector     = "keyword"
  keywords     = ["project falcon", "project osprey"]
  action       = "warn"
  severity     = "low"
}

# Block known secret formats.
resource "routeur_dlp_policy" "secrets" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "secrets"
  name         = "Secrets"
  detector     = "secret"
  secrets      = ["adobe-client-id", "1password-secret-key"]
  action       = "block"
  severity     = "high"
  enabled      = false
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What happens on a match: `log`, `warn`, `redact`, `tokenize` or `block`. `tokenize` (reversible redaction) needs a plan that includes it, otherwise the API refuses the policy.
- `detector` (String) What the policy detects: `regex`, `preset`, `keyword` or `secret`. Set the matching payload argument (`pattern`, `presets`, `keywords` or `secrets`) and no other.
- `name` (String) Unique in the workspace, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `severity` (String) `low`, `medium` or `high`.
- `slug` (String) Unique in the workspace, lowercase letters and digits joined by single underscores, at most 64 characters. It is the policy's identifier in a trace's `dlp_matched_policies`, so changing it renames that identifier.
- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enforced. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the policy again.
- `keywords` (Set of String) Case-insensitive substrings to match. A set: order does not matter. Items have no commas or surrounding whitespace. Only with `detector = "keyword"`.
- `pattern` (String) RE2 regular expression (not PCRE: no lookarounds or backreferences), at most 2000 characters. Stored verbatim. Only with `detector = "regex"`.
- `presets` (Set of String) Managed preset ids: `email`, `phone`, `credit_card`, `iban`, `us_aba_routing`, `swift_bic`, `us_ssn`, `us_itin`, `uk_nhs_number`, `uk_nino`, `es_dni`, `it_fiscal_code`, `in_aadhaar`, `ca_sin` or `ip_address`; older policies may also use `aws_key`, `github_token`, `jwt` and `private_key`, but credentials are better matched with `detector = "secret"`. See the [presets reference](https://docs.routeur.ai/guides/presets#dlp) for what each one matches. New presets may be added; the API refuses an unknown id. A set: order does not matter. Items have no commas or surrounding whitespace. Only with `detector = "preset"`.
- `project_id` (String) Scope the policy to one project in this workspace (`proj_…`). Omit it to apply to every project in the workspace. Changing it updates the policy in place.
- `secrets` (Set of String) Secret-format ids, such as `aws-access-token`, `github-pat` or `1password-secret-key`. Every selectable id is listed in [Secret formats](https://docs.routeur.ai/guides/secret-formats); the API refuses an unknown id. A set: order does not matter. Items have no commas or surrounding whitespace. Only with `detector = "secret"`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the policy (`dlp_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>/<policy_id>
import {
  to = routeur_dlp_policy.pii
  id = "ws_3/dlp_12"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>/<policy_id>
terraform import routeur_dlp_policy.pii ws_3/dlp_12
```
